title: An interactive map of all 9,110 NeurIPS 2026 papers, and what changed since 2025 [P]
summary: I embedded the title and abstract of every NeurIPS 2026 paper (and every 2025 paper) with Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B, grouped them into 150 topics and 20 areas, and put them on one map with DataMapPlot. Both years are measured on the same topics, so you can see what grew and what shran
